From 30.01.2022 12:20

item.title: Just Dance - Final Year at the Paris Conservatoire (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (29.12.2023)
item.description:
They are 18 years old and starting their final year of dance training at the prestigious Paris Conservatoire. They not only have to pass their exams, but also land a contract with a company. With auditions coming thick and fast, the pressure is on, and there's no room for error in the ultra-selective world of dance.
From 29.12.2023 14:30

item.title: BPM Ecstasy: The Techno Scene in Beijing and Taipei (2/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.12.2023)
item.description:
SUNK visits a legend in the Beijing techno scene: DJ Youdai switched on a generation to electronic dance music and raves.
From 12.12.2023 17:35

item.title: #AMINORMAL (2/8) - Managing a Long Distance Relationship (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.01.2022)
item.description:
Is it possible to have an addiction to the internet when most daily tasks require the Internet? That's especially true for couples who've only ever met online and depend on technology to keep the relationship going. For them, spending more than 7 hours a day on their phone is normal. But the DSM would describe them as addicts.
From 30.01.2022 11:59

item.title: Tracks East - The Millennials of the Balkans (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.05.2023)
item.description:
Since the wars that devastated the Balkans in the 1990s, the international community has continued to associate Southeastern Europe with a powder keg. Tracks East has therefore chosen to give a voice to young artists from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, and Kosovo who strive to portray a different image of this region of the world.
From 30.05.2023 09:52

item.title: Tracks East - Parallel Worlds at War (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.11.2023)
item.description:
The children of the Russian elite live out their dreams while their non-elite compatriots are sent to the front in Ukraine, invoking a well-connected parent allows them to escape mobilisation. Exiled Russian journalist Masha Borzunova sheds light on these parallel worlds.
From 07.11.2023 12:04

item.title: How Streaming Consumed Music (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (19.09.2023)
item.description:
Having every piece of music imaginable in your pocket is normal today, but it took several a lot of upheaval in the music industry to get us there. Music-lover and journalist Sophian Fanen tells us how we went from CDs to streaming, from scarcity to infinite access. He traces the history of our listening habits in the 21st century through the mp3, illegal downloads, the iPod, to streaming services.....
From 19.09.2023 19:30

item.title: We Wear the Crown - 40 Years of German Rap (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.11.2021)
item.description:
In 1980, Thomas Gottschalk rapped a German version of Rappers Delight on TV. Next, Falco had a worldwide hit with Der Kommissar. It was the start of a German rap movement, and breakdancing swept over Germany. We take a nostalgic look back on the 80s and 90s cool kids of rap.
From 12.11.2021 14:39

item.title: Tracks East - Social Activism in Wartime (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.10.2023)
item.description:
When war disrupts daily life, social issues often take a back seat. Tracks East meets the men and women who refuse to let armed conflict get in their way. Anna, a doctor in Kyiv, wants sexual liberation along with sexual health and Alina and Stanislava are campaigning for equal marriage.
From 24.10.2023 11:37

item.title: In-Game Photography - Art of Gaming (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.02.2022)
item.description:
Video game photographer Martin Geisler shows us with examples from “Skyrim”, “the Hunter” and “Squad” that photography within gameplay has become as art form.
From 02.02.2022 08:01

item.title: Tracks: Songwriting Special - Pop Music: The Great Recycling Business (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.04.2022)
item.description:
Have you ever wondered why pop songs sometimes sound a little too familiar? Welcome to the world of pop-recycling where borrowing, sampling and interpolation are the order of the day. Featuring interviews with Placebo, Ed Sheeran, Charlie XCX and Lauv.
From 11.04.2022 15:20

item.title: Tracks East - Daily life in Putin's Russia (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (26.09.2023)
item.description:
Eighteen months after Russia invaded Ukraine, how is Russian civil society coping with Putin’s dictatorial drift? Tracks East investigates with journalist and debunker of fake news, Masha Borzunova.
From 26.09.2023 16:33

item.title: Tracks - Russian Artists Against the War (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (04.04.2022)
item.description:
Russian artists have two choices: silence, or exile. There's been a mass creative exodus in recent weeks, including Russian rap stars like Face and Oxxxymiron. Art rockers IC3PEAK post protest videos that would get them arrested in Russia. TikTok star Nikita Sass bravely continues to post his opinion and stays. Few dare to do that.
From 04.04.2022 10:03

item.title: Kate Superstar (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.03.2024)
item.description:
With an Instagram following of 15 million, Catherine Elizabeth Middleton is perhaps the most popular member of the British Royal Family. A portrait of the Princess of Wales, a fascinating figure, style icon, and popular celebrity who is modernising the image of the monarchy.
From 01.03.2024 05:00

item.title: Ecko Bazz / Political Bodies / Jean Lecointre / Alexeï German Jr - Tracks (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.12.2021)
item.description:
Ugandan MC Ecko Bazz offers up the soundtrack of his worst nightmares. Also in the programme: Guatemalan artist and poet Regina José Galindo and Afghan artist Kubra Khademi, Jean Lecointre, the Frankenstein of collage and Russian filmmaker Alexei Guerman Jr.
From 05.12.2021 22:00

item.title: Tracks East - Fear and Repression in Belarus (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.02.2024)
item.description:
Since the anti-government protests in Belarus in 2020, the international media has disappeared. But the population still lives in fear with the secret service hunting down dissidents by analysing video footage of the protest using AI. Tracks East meets with Belarusians to find out what life is like in the country.
From 06.02.2024 14:30

item.title: The Singing Nun - Who Killed the Voice of God? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.10.2023)
item.description:
Sister Smile released her hit single Dominique in 1962, before an appearance on the Ed Sullivan Show catapulted “The Singing Nun” to the top of the US charts. But Sister Smile, real name Jeanne Deckers, became a plaything of the almighty music industry, and the Catholic Church. A closeted gay woman, her life was tragically cut short by suicide. 
From 24.10.2023 13:00

item.title: Tracks - Influencers in MMA (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.12.2023)
item.description:
Influencers and musicians in Germany are stepping into the Mixed Martial Arts ring to fight in front of sell-out crowds. What does this mean for professionals in the sport?
From 14.12.2023 16:16

item.title: Tracks East - The Polish Paradox (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (29.09.2023)
item.description:
Tracks East finds out how militarisation, migration, and an increasing polarisation within society are affecting the mood in Poland as elections approach.
From 29.09.2023 15:47

item.title: Tracks Inside - Techno & TikTok (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.03.2024)
item.description:
During the Covid pandemic, techno went big online. Whether on TikTok, in the charts or analogue at raves: Generation-Z is addicted to raving. Tracks meets rapper Ski Aggu and DJs Tham and Alva and asks what all the hype means for the techno scene.
From 01.03.2024 10:00

item.title: Tracks East - Iranian Women Resist (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.09.2023)
item.description:
In September 2022 the death of Mahsa Amini in police custody set off nationwide protests in Iran. One year on from this civil unrest, Tracks East meets the ultra-connected younger generation who demonstrate their opposition to the government through art and music.
From 15.09.2023 15:14

item.title: Tracks East - Roots! Where Do You Come From? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.06.2023)
item.description:
Who am I and where do I belong? Tracks East brings together artists who are asking themselves the fundamental question of their origins and identity.
From 20.06.2023 11:34

item.title: Tracks East - Fashion as Identity (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (18.01.2024)
item.description:
Through our clothes, we assert our identity and our convictions and take part in the debates that drive our society. The decision to wear or not to wear becomes political. In this episode, Tracks East takes an in-depth look at the political dimension of fashion.
From 18.01.2024 10:53

item.title: Tracks - The Power of Afrobeat (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (09.01.2024)
item.description:
Afrobeat or afrobeats, a more general overarching term, is taking the world by storm. Nigerian artists are at the forefront of a genre that is gaining recognition in Europe. Tracks goes to Berlin to meet singer Rose May Alaba at the Afrobeats Festival.
From 09.01.2024 14:28

item.title: Tracks East - Protests, Parties, Death (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.03.2024)
item.description:
With the outcome of the presidential election in mid-March in little doubt, Tracks East meets Russians, at home and in exile, to find out what they are thinking, just a short time after the death of Navalny.
From 12.03.2024 10:13

item.title: Tracks East - Israel: Life After Terror (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.11.2023)
item.description:
In Israel everything changed overnight on 7 October. In this episode, Tracks East looks at life in the Jewish state after the Hamas attack.
From 17.11.2023 18:47

item.title: Tracks East - Anti-war Folklore (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.09.2023)
item.description:
Since Russia invaded its neighbour, Ukrainian culture has been enjoying a revival. Folklore in particular is a means of resisting the invader by strengthening the country's cultural identity. Tracks East looks at the craze for traditional song and dance as well as the refusal of some artists to express their patriotism through music.
From 14.09.2023 14:12

item.title: Tracks East - Summer, Sun...and War (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.07.2023)
item.description:
Summer in Europe is here, but with war raging in the east, is it even possible to go on holiday? In Ukraine some are trying to enjoy the beaches around Odessa and in the Russian resort of Sochi, the atmosphere is tense.
From 06.07.2023 11:42

item.title: Tracks East - Food: A Weapon of War (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.09.2023)
item.description:
With the war in Ukraine, the spectre of a new food crisis is haunting Africa. Tracks East witnesses an artistic performance that revives the trauma of the great famine that decimated Ukraine in the 1930s. Ukrainian farmers working the land today are coming under Russian machine-gun fire. Finally, we head for Nairobi, where the distant war is weighing heavily on local people’s wallets.
From 14.09.2023 17:08

item.title: #AMINORMAL (4/8) - How to Survive Your Period (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.01.2022)
item.description:
The womb may create life, but it can also make life pretty miserable. The women interviewed here tell us how they experience bad mood swings before menstruation. This is normal unless you read the DSM: after “premenstrual syndrome”, the latest edition establishes a more severe disorder, known as premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD).
From 30.01.2022 12:08

item.title: Tracks Inside (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.07.2023)
item.description:
Psychedelic drugs as a miracle cure for mental health? In Europe and the USA, investors are pouring hug sums into research and psychedelic trips branded as wellness weekends are becoming more common. Tracks investigates the claims and the dangers.
From 20.07.2023 17:08

item.title: Draw for Change - Syria: Cartoonist Amany Al-Ali (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.03.2024)
item.description:
Cartoonist Amany Al-Ali lives in Idlib, a free Syrian city which feels anything but free: Regular bombings by government forces on the one hand and the weight of a conformist traditional society on the other means life is hard. But the difficult  life in Idlib feeds Al-Ali’s art.
From 06.03.2024 05:00

item.title: BPM Ecstasy: The Techno Scene in Beijing and Taipei (1/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.12.2023)
item.description:
In Beijing SUNK’s techno production is influenced by her interest in traditional Chinese culture. IN Taipei, Elvis T discovers a scene rising from the ashes.
From 11.12.2023 14:32

item.title: Tracks East - When Politics Destroys Families (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.06.2023)
item.description:
The family should be a haven of peace, a model of cohesion. But what happens to this cocoon when it is shaken by political conflict and war? Some try to reinvent the bond while others cut ties.
From 20.06.2023 11:03

item.title: Tracks East - Kosovo: Artists against Escalation (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.02.2024)
item.description:
More than twenty years after the end of the fighting between Kosovo and Serbia,  history continues to cast its dark shadow. The recent upsurge in tensions between the two countries is making matters worse. Tracks East met the artists who want to build bridges between communities.
From 15.02.2024 15:46

item.title: NFT Chaos in the Art Market - Disillusion (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.01.2024)
item.description:
In the space of a few months, billions of dollars were lost and major companies had to file for bankruptcy. The price of NFTs plummeted. Will the utopia of non-fungible tokens survive the financial collapse? Has the digital art market found stabiity?
From 25.01.2024 09:52

item.title: Tracks East - War. Freedom. Human rights. (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.12.2023)
item.description:
Tracks East looks at the human rights situation in several parts of the world: Freedom of expression in Russia, Women’s rights in Iran, the inhabitants of Gaza under bombardment, and the forced exile of the Armenian population of Nagorno-Karabakh.
From 07.12.2023 17:58

item.title: Tracks East - Scarred: Ukrainians Defy the Trauma of War (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.02.2024)
item.description:
After almost two years of war, Ukraine is a traumatised nation. A large proportion of the population is suffering from physical or psychological injuries, and often both. Tracks East looks at how the country is coping with mass trauma.
From 07.02.2024 16:54

item.title: BPM Ecstasy: The Techno Scene in Beijing and Taipei (4/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.01.2024)
item.description:
After a trip to Fruityspace, Beijing's most famous indie record shop, SUNK plays her first gig. Meanwhile, tamiX prepares to go abroad for the first time since the pandemic.
From 15.01.2024 15:28

item.title: Tracks - Berlin's Floating Alternative Scene (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.12.2023)
item.description:
In Berlin, clubs and alternative spaces are closing and rents are soaring. But in one of the capital's richest districts, there is resistance. On the shores of Rummelsburg lake, behind Ostkreuz station, alternative groups have built makeshift barges in defiance of the Berlin property market.
From 08.12.2023 13:57

item.title: #AMINORMAL (3/8) - ADHD in Older People (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.01.2022)
item.description:
These seniors admit that they talk too much, forget appointments and have been bored since they retired. Like all grandparents would tell us: they are getting old, so it's normal. But the DSM says that these could be signs of ADHD.
From 30.01.2022 12:03

item.title: Tracks East - Enemies Forever? Voices against Hate in the Middle East (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.02.2024)
item.description:
Since the Hamas attack and Israel's response, the conflict in the Middle East has escalated with much loss of life. Yet some voices are calling for reconciliation.
From 02.02.2024 18:09

item.title: Tracks East - The Dead Don't Die: Never Forgetting (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.10.2023)
item.description:
At the front, the war continues, but for Ukrainians, the process of remembering has already begun. How can the country honour its many dead while conflict endures? In this episode, Tracks East looks at the way in which men and women evoke the past and perpetuate its memory.
From 17.10.2023 14:47

item.title: Tracks East - This is my body! (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.06.2023)
item.description:
In many countries, the state wants to control your body: the clothes you wear, your facial hair and for women, even their pregnancies. Tracks East meets Polish journalist and mixed martial-arts fighter Maja Staśko to find out the situation in Poland and the world.
From 13.06.2023 13:20

item.title: Tracks East - Cancel Russia? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.06.2023)
item.description:
Since Russia invaded its neighbour Ukraine, many are demanding cultural institutions not to programme Russian works. Is leaving out Tchaikovsky's "Swan Lake" or Chekhov's "Three Sisters" already a form of cancel culture? 
From 06.06.2023 17:40

item.title: Tracks East - Eurovision: Pop and Politics (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.05.2023)
item.description:
For many, the Eurovision Song Contest is the chance for a Pan-European party. But it is also highly political, especially for countries in Eastern Europe. When Ukrainian group Kalush Orchestra won in 2022, it was a message of European solidarity against Russian aggression.
From 03.05.2023 17:41

item.title: Tracks East - Turkey: The New Generation (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (10.05.2023)
item.description:
A new generation has come of age in Turkey that doesn’t want to live like their parents. On social media, on comedy stages and in rap music a counterculture is flourishing. Filmmaker Ufuk Cam goes to Turkey to uncover the local scene.
From 10.05.2023 17:37

item.title: It's Yours - The Story of Hip Hop and the Internet (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (18.10.2021)
item.description:
In the early 2000s, the successes of US hip-hop artists like Lil B, Wiz Khalifa or Tyler The Creator, was thanks to their mastery of the Internet. They broke away from traditional sales models, and the hip-hop community forged its own way into mainstream recognition without the help of music execs.
From 18.10.2021 18:41

item.title: Saarland - Germany - Terroir Cuisine (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (31.03.2024)
item.description:
Often derided as a weed, the humble dandelion is considered a delicacy in the German Saarland region where it is used in salads and celebrated for its healthy properties and taste.
From 31.03.2024 05:00

item.title: 360° Geo: Santa Cruz del Islote - A Unique Island (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.04.2024)
item.description:
Off the Caribbean coast of Columbia lies the tiny island of Santa Cruz del Islote. Life on possibly the most densely populated island on Earth is beauiful but complicated.
From 06.04.2024 05:00

item.title: Japan's Tattooed Heroes (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.01.2024)
item.description:
Japan is admired worldwide for its traditions and arts. From opulent fabrics to impressive wood carvings and calligraphy. But one art form has almost been forgotten: the traditional tattoo - the Horimono. Once highly popular, it has now become the symbol of the criminal yakuza, and its true history is barely known.
From 21.01.2024 05:00

item.title: 360° Reportage - New York Food Trucks (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.02.2024)
item.description:
Food trucks are everywhere in New York, especially in Astoria, Queens, a district that symbolises the American melting pot more than any other: Nowhere else is there such linguistic and cultural diversity. The result is a rich food culture with culinary specialities from all over the world.
From 05.02.2024 15:39

item.title: 360° GEO - The Secret Forest of Spree (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.03.2024)
item.description:
An hour drive from Berlin, the Spreewald region is a small green paradise, crossed by countless rivers and canals. Some villages are accessible only by boat. This place is frozen in time, with its traditions still a part of local life.
From 23.03.2024 05:00

item.title: 360° Reportage - Bolivia: Cholita Skateboarders (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.02.2024)
item.description:
At the highest skatepark in the world, in Bolivia, young indigenous women known as cholitas are taking up skateboarding. It’s a way to throw off out-dated stereotypes about indigenous women, who have long suffered from marginalisation in the South American country.
From 15.02.2024 16:58

item.title: 360° Reportage - Rapa Nui - Gladiators of the Pacific (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (29.01.2024)
item.description:
Called Rapa Nui by its inhabitants, Easter Island is the most isolated island in the world. February is when the Tapati celebrations take place, a week-long festival with some thirty sporting and cultural events which islanders take part in. The highlight is a local twist on a triathlon in which participants paddle, run and swim.
From 29.01.2024 12:11

item.title: The Isle of Rum (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.02.2024)
item.description:
The Scottish island of Rum is a remote paradise with only 35 residents. In this real island community we find Dave, the guitar-playing harbour master, Kim who runs the island’s tea shop, and Fergus, who is making rum on the island for the first time with local ingredients
From 03.02.2024 05:00

item.title: 360° Reportage - Australia: Mission Platypus (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (22.01.2024)
item.description:
The platypus is a very strange species in a country with many unusual animals. Equipped with their characteristic beaks and thick fur, they are a fascinating hybrid which lay eggs  like birds or reptiles, and yet nurse their young like mammals. In the last few hundred years they have become increasingly endangered but new protection and resettlement schemes are ensuring a comeback.
From 22.01.2024 05:00

item.title: Hargila - Indian Women Save the Stork (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (27.01.2024)
item.description:
The hargila or Greater adjutant, one of the largest storks on the planet, was listed as endangered in 2014. Although this huge scavenger plays an essential role in the ecological balance of Asia's wetlands, it still has a bad reputation. In India, it is considered a bad omen and its nests are often destroyed. But a group of local women are trying to save this misunderstood bird by forming a grassr.....
From 27.01.2024 05:00

item.title: 360° Reportage - Brazilian Rainforest: Back to the Future (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.03.2024)
item.description:
In the Amazon region, indigenous communities have often adopted a Western lifestyle and farming techniques. But faced with failing crops, disease, and poverty, attitudes are changing. In a growing number of villages, locals are returning to their old way of life, growing indigenous species in the old way.
From 07.03.2024 12:54

item.title: Kingdoms of Fire, Ice and Fairy Tales (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.04.2024)
item.description:
Two filmmakers explore three of the planet’s epic wildernesses: places that inspire awe and wonder from the freezing Arctic to Germany's magical Black Forest and America's iconic and majestic Yellowstone National Park.
From 02.04.2024 05:00

item.title: The Halligen Islands Under Water (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (28.02.2024)
item.description:
The Wadden Sea National Park, which stretches from the Netherlands to Denmark, is punctuated by a string of islands endowed with a unique geological feature: due to their very low elevation, they are are regularly flooded at high tide. This unique characteristic results in a rare biosphere,where mudflats, sandbanks, meadows and salt marshes succeed one another.
From 28.02.2024 05:00

item.title: Kodiak Brown Bears - Alaskan Giants (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.03.2024)
item.description:
Alaska's bears must adapt to the changing climate. The documentary follows the lives of several bear families over two years, revealing how grizzlies on mainland Alaska and Kodiak bears on Kodiak Island are coping with a warming planet.
From 06.03.2024 05:00

item.title: A Journey through the Baltic States (2/2) - Lithuania and Latvia (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (04.03.2024)
item.description:
The Baltic states are renowned for their great diversity of landscapes. In this second part we discover the Curonian Spit in western Lithuania, a UNESCO world heritage site known as the Pearl of the Baltic, and the Daugavas Loki nature park in Latvia.
From 04.03.2024 11:25

item.title: A Journey through the Baltic States (1/2) - Estonia and Latvia (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (04.03.2024)
item.description:
The Baltic States are blessed with beautiful unspoilt wildernesses that are as rich in flora and fauna as they are in human tradition.  In this episode we visit the island of Kihnu and the Alutaguse national park in Estonia, as well as the Pape nature reserve in Latvia.
From 04.03.2024 10:45

item.title: Wild Costa Rica - A Sanctuary of Biodiversity (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.03.2024)
item.description:
Costa Rica is unique with an abundance of ecosystems, rich in flora and fauna. Thanks to a proactive and innovative ecological policy, it is today one of the few countries in the world to see its forest cover grow significantly year on year. This documentary is a journey into the heart of a true sanctuary of biodiversity.
From 20.03.2024 11:31

item.title: Mafia and Banks (2/3) - Follow the Money (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.01.2024)
item.description:
This three-part documentary tells the little-known story of the alliances between criminal organisations and financial institutions from the 1920s to the present day. Episode 2: the 1980s banking deregulation coincided with the rise of the heroin and cocaine trade in the USA. The result was a bonanza for drug traffickers and banks.
From 25.01.2024 16:30

item.title: The Life Ahead of Us (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.02.2024)
item.description:
Based on research by Ariane Chemin, this documentary tells the story of how French soldier Félix Mora recruited young Moroccans en masse for the mines of industrial France in the 1960s and 1970s as the French economy was booming. This recruitment led to a new generation of working-class French citizens through immigration.
From 15.02.2024 15:00

item.title: Corleone, A History of La Cosa Nostra (2/2) - The Fall (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.11.2023)
item.description:
Judge Giovanni Falcone starts off the first trial of the Sicilian mafia, convicting a member to life imprisonment. The mafia is out for revenge. 
From 21.11.2023 05:00

item.title: The Battle of Chile (3/3) - People Power (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (12.09.2023)
item.description:
In the months leading up to the military coup in Chile, supporters of the socialist president Allende try to create a " state within a state " with political and charitable actions - as a counterweight to the anti-reform forces in the country, supported by the Nixon administration in the USA.
From 12.09.2023 12:30

item.title: Capitalism in America - The Cult of Wealth (3/3) - Who Wants to be a Billionaire? (1981 - Today) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.11.2023)
item.description:
In the 1980s, Ronald Reagan and the republicans pushed through policies of deregulation and tax cuts whilst Silicon Valley became the new Eldorado for young companies such as Apple and Microsoft. As the internet grew, capital flowed into big tech making huge fortunes and monopolies. The poor and middle classes paid their taxes and the rich paid less.
From 07.11.2023 05:00

item.title: The Power of the German Constitutional Court (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (04.12.2021)
item.description:
The Federal Constitutional Court was founded 70 years ago. It is one of the most powerful institutions in Germany, along with the federal government, parliament and the Federal President. Often hostile to politics and respected by Germans, it has shaped the Federal Republic. But do these judges have too much power given they don't have a democratic mandate?
From 04.12.2021 21:53

item.title: Marie Laguerre, Street Harassment Hero - Domino Effect (2/4) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.08.2021)
item.description:
Maire Laguerre was walking home from work when she was sexually harassed by a man in the street. When she told her aggressor to get lost, he threw an ashtray at her and punched her in the face. She decided to post the video of her attack online and it went viral, eventually triggering a change in street harassment laws in France.
From 24.08.2021 20:19

item.title: Ghettos of the Holocaust (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.01.2024)
item.description:
In 1938, the Nazis first considered establishing so-called "Jewish residential districts". One year later, the first ghettos were established in Nazi-occupied Poland. This documentary tells the gruesome story of the Jewish ghettos based on records written by their inhabitants. They bear witness to the human tragedy of the holocaust, but also to an indomitable will to live.
From 23.01.2024 14:30

item.title: The Battle of Chile (1/3) - The Insurrection of the Bourgeoisie (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.09.2023)
